heroSub: FiveStar AI e rala le ho aha mofuta o mong le o mong oa software — mobile, web, desktop, backend, le AI — e sebelisa LLM ho sebetsa lipuong tsohle tsa mananeo le mekotla ea theknoloji.
m1Sub: AI ho pholletsa le moralo, likhoutu le QA
m2Sub: Puo efe kapa efe, sethala kapa moralo
m3Sub: Ho tloha ho prototype ho isa tlhahiso
m4Sub: Qala, sebetsa 'me u tsoele pele ho ntlafatsa
aboutLead: Re k'hamphani ea software ea AI e nang le boiphihlelo bo tebileng ho nts'etsopele e tsamaisoang ke LLM. Re fetola mathata a khoebo lihlahisoa tse tšepahalang ntle le ho lekanyetsoa ke puo e itseng ea lenaneo, sethala, kapa stack ea theknoloji.
missionTitle: Software e fetang mekoallo ea puo
missionBody: Re sebelisa AI le LLMs ho khetha lisebelisoa tse nepahetseng bakeng sa bothata bo bong le bo bong le ho tsamaisa mekotla ea theknoloji.
principlesTitle: Thuso ea AI · Motho ea ikarabellang
principlesBody: AI e potlakisa mosebetsi; baenjiniere ba rona ba lula ba ikarabella bakeng sa meralo, boleng, polokeho le liphetho.
focusTitle: Mofuta o mong le o mong oa software
focusBody: Mobile, web, desktop, backend, AI agents, data systems, le workflow automation.
productsLead: Lihlahisoa tsa rona li bonts'a hore na re nka mehopolo joang ho qala ho AI, mehala, litokomane, media le software ea tlhahiso.
p1: Mokhoa oa OCR bakeng sa litokomane tse skeniloeng: ntsha, batla, akaretsa, TTS—e tsepamisitseng maikutlo ho privacy ka tshebetso ea lehae.
p2: Sebapali se bonolo sa media sa lehae se se nang lipapatso le boiphihlelo bo bonolo ho li-platform tsa mobile.
p4: Software e kopanang le AI ea lehae ho lumella tshebetso e arolaneng le lipuisano tsa private.
p5: Etsa hore screenshot tsa App Store li be bonolo ho li fetolela le ho li lokisa ho latela lipuo bakeng sa ho li romela.
p6: Palo e haufi e theililoeng ka tumello ka Bluetooth, e nang le phetolelo ea AI ea lehae e khethiloeng. Ha ho na akhaonto, ha ho na seva ya palo ea bo pusatsi.
p7: Motsamaisi oa lipase e lemang sebaka. E bontša khuputone kapa karet ea sengoloane e nepahetseng nakong eo u fihlang.
p3: Ho tloha lits'ebetsong tsa ka hare le lits'ebeletso tsa marang-rang ho isa ho lisebelisoa tsa mobile, desktop, le AI. Re khetha puo e ntle ka ho fetisisa le stack bakeng sa bothata bo bong le bo bong.
b1: Lisebelisoa tsa LLM le liakhente tsa AI
b3: Backend, li-API le litsamaiso tsa cloud
b4: Ho sebetsa ka boits'oaro le ts'ebetso ea data
q2: Teko e itirisang le tlhahlobo ea khoutu
q4: Tlhokomelo le ntlafatso ea nako e telele
servicesLead: Boenjiniere bo potlakileng ba LLM bo fetola bothata bo hlalositsoeng hantle hore e be software e sebetsang kapele.
s1Body: Hlalosa sepheo sa khoebo, basebelisi, lithibelo, le mokhoa o nepahetseng oa tekheniki.
s2Body: Sebelisa boenjineri bo thusitsoeng ke LLM ho rala, ho kenya tšebetsong, ho leka, le ho pheta-pheta lipolanete.
s3Body: Tsamaisa, beha leihlo, sebetsa, 'me u tsoele pele ho ntlafatsa sehlahisoa.
contactLead: Re bolelle seo u batlang ho se haha. Re tla fana ka maikutlo a tsela e sebetsang ho tloha mohopolong ho qala.
